# Analysis Page

The Analysis page is a central feature of PlaViSca, designed to facilitate interactive exploration of both metadata and gene expression data. The page is organized into five tabs, each focusing on a distinct aspect of data analysis:

## Metadata

<iframe width="100%" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/OVQYo1mZfok" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

A short video demonstration of the Metadata tab is available above. This video provides an overview of how to filter datasets by biological and experimental attributes, such as species, reproductive form, infection condition, parasite stage, and sample ID. Applying filters dynamically updates both plots and tables, enabling users to focus on relevant data subsets for further analysis.

Interactive features include:
- **Plotly Charts:** Hover to view detailed values. Additional controls (zoom, pan, selection, download) are accessible in the chart's top-right corner.
- **DT Table:** Provides a global search box for keyword-based filtering and column-specific filters for precise data selection and export as a CSV file.

## Quality Control

![Quality control image](imgs/quality_control.png)

The Quality Control tab provides visualizations to assess the integrity of single-cell RNA sequencing data, including:
- RNA Count vs. Sample
- nFeature Count vs. Sample
- Standard Deviation Plot of PCA
- Standard Variation vs. Mean Expression Plot

All plots support interactive filtering, enabling targeted quality assessment based on user-defined thresholds.

## Data Source

![Data source image](imgs/data_source.png)

The Data Source section provides detailed documentation and attribution for the datasets utilized within PlaViSca. It includes comprehensive metadata such as journal names, publication dates, article titles, authors, and DOI links, enabling users to directly access the original publications. This ensures transparency, facilitates reproducibility, and appropriately credits the contributors of the datasets.

## Gene Expression

<iframe width="100%" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Pqz_eRX3lrg" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

The Gene Expression tab provides an interactive interface for exploring gene expression across various biological conditions. Users can:
- Add or remove plots as needed
- Select data type (Raw, Normalized, Scaled)
- Toggle between Gene Names and Gene IDs
- Search and select specific genes
- Group data by variables such as stage, species, or reproductive form

Each selection generates a dynamic violin plot with interactive filtering, hover tooltips, and download options. Direct links to PlasmoDB and NCBI facilitate access to gene annotations.

## Embedding

<iframe width="100%" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8nqulHcMge0" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

The Embedding tab offers tools for dimensionality reduction and customizable filtering of single-cell data. Users can:
- Apply multiple filters using OR logic within fields and AND logic between fields
- Color scatter plots by any metadata column or gene expression
- Select clustering-based coloring (CCA_sn) with adjustable resolution
- Choose data type and gene identifier for expression-based coloring
- Customize plot appearance (point size, 2D/3D, axis selection)
- Toggle between integrated and unintegrated datasets
- Select dimensionality reduction method (UMAP, t-SNE, PCA)
- Download plots for further use

### Interactive Cell Selection

Clicking on individual cells displays a popup table with gene names, IDs, expression values, and descriptions. This data can be exported as CSV for downstream analysis.
